title: Host lease refusal
current: Host operations diagnose missing, unbound, mismatched, foreign and inactive leases with their actual state, machine and holding session or actor when known. A local Command case declares method_config.machine and obtains custody through the existing plan host admission path; authoring refuses a Command whose body calls yoke test-machine without method_config.machine, and the test_machine_leased refusal of yoke test-machine exec names that field as the case's recovery; its own active plan can run a nested reset and retains its lease through submission. The steering report joins reset debt to live execution custody, including companion hosts: a held host reads reset owed after the execution with no recovery command; an unheld host reads machine_needs_repair with its reset command. An awaiting mission cannot reset or verify its live host: finish or abort that mission first. A released lease with no receipt requires evidence inspection and receipt recovery, never repeating the host action.
desired: Deployed proof that the declared-host Command waits for admission, runs its nested reset as leaseholder and preserves host custody until its plan settles.
